name: Sister
source:
The head nun at the school, Sister is also the teacher of Rie and Midori. A woman with a pure heart on the surface, she also bears a secret she can never tell to another.

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/P020]J-List[/url]]

[spoiler]The mother of Naomi and Rie.[/spoiler]
